data.notes: Confirmed March 2027 music listings are still sparse in Courchevel proper, so this calendar includes fixed-date official Courchevel items plus nearby 3 Vallées après-ski DJ programming.

events.title: Rave Experience #3
events.summary: °Fahrenheit Seven Val Thorens lists Rave Experience #3 for March 23, 2027, from 15:00 to 19:00, with the lineup announced in March. The venue describes the Rave Experience concept as a hard-house and trance-focused après-ski format created with VIDO.

events.title: Snowfest 2027 après-ski DJ sets
events.summary: The nearby 3 Vallées hotel-party hub °Fahrenheit Seven Val Thorens lists Snowfest 2027 après-ski DJ sets from March 15 to March 18, 2027, including Romanian-themed terrace sessions from 15:00 to 19:00. This is a fixed-date mountain après-ski series within the wider Courchevel-accessible ski area.

events.title: Ski Show and Light Show - Courchevel 1850 DJ Set
events.summary: Courchevel 1850’s ESF ski show and light show is followed by a 6:00 pm DJ set on the snow front. The official Courchevel page lists the event for Thursday, March 4, 2027, weather permitting.

events.title: DJ Set et dîner festif
events.summary: A weekly Wednesday festive dinner and DJ set in Méribel Centre, with the dancefloor open from 21:00. Méribel’s official agenda lists March 3, 2027 as a confirmed March occurrence.
